page_title: HEI 0-0 HOF | Heidenheim v Hoffenheim 27/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+3' Hoffenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+3' Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Kevin Muller pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
90+2' Heidenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Yellow card. Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
85' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) will replace Paul Wanner.
83' Tom Bischof will be replaced by Diadie Samassekou (Hoffenheim).
83' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) replacing Stanley Nsoki.

83' Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Kevin Muller has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
82' Heidenheim fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
81' Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.
78' Christian Dingert blows his whistle after Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
76' Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
75' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
74' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing.
73' The resulting set piece from Heidenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Heidenheim earn a corner.

72' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the bottom right corner, but Oliver Baumann made a superb athletic save to deny him.
71' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) gets to a rebound in the six-yard box and his effort smashes off the crossbar.
70' Substitution. Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) on for Niklas Dorsch.
70' Here is a change. Marvin Pieringer is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim).
67' The substitution has been made. Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) has replaced Marius Bulter.
67' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
65' A spell of possession for Hoffenheim in an attempt to control the game.
64' The percentage of ball possession is – 44:56.
62' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
61' That was close by Leo Scienza (Heidenheim)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
60' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
59' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
58' Pellegrino Matarazzo prepares a substitution. Valentin Gendrey is replaced by Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim).
58' That will be all from Florian Grillitsch who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim).
57' The Hoffenheim players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
53' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
52' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
51' A pass into the box finds Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Kevin Muller denies him.
51' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
49' Referee Christian Dingert sees the trip by Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
48' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.

46' A sweet pass finds Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball low towards the middle of the goal. Kevin Muller is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
46' Hoffenheim players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Christian Dingert has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
41' Some patient build-up play from Hoffenheim as they look to unlock the defence.
40' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
39' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
34' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Heidenheim, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
33' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
32' What was Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
29' An attempted cross from Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) is cleared.
25' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
25' Hoffenheim control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
23' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
23' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
21' Corner kicks – 1:2.

20' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Christian Dingert blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
19' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) wasted a huge opportunity as he received a fine cross from the free kick and fired a shot in from just outside of the box, but it sailed high over the crossbar.
18' Christian Dingert blows his whistle and signals a foul after Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) brought his opponent down.
17' A quickly taken corner by Hoffenheim.
15' Heidenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
14' A cross from a corner kick by Hoffenheim is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
13' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box found Leo Scienza (Heidenheim), whose header floated just over the bar.
8' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.

5' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
5' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
1' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
